changeSet.sql:
ALTER FUNCTION [utility].[GetFormattedFieldLookupValueWithMultiple] ( @Type varchar(25), @DisplayFormat nvarchar(250), @LookupObjectType varchar(25), @LookupObjectID int, @Value nvarchar(max), @SupportsMultipleValues bit ) RETURNS nvarchar(max) AS BEGIN declare @formattedValue nvarchar(max)
if @Value is null or (@Value = '' and @LookupObjectID is not null) begin return null end
if @LookupObjectType is null begin set @formattedValue = @Value
if @Type = 'Link' OR @Type = 'UncLink' begin set @formattedValue = [utility].[GetFormattedFieldLinkValue] (@Value) end
end else begin if @SupportsMultipleValues = 1 begin set @formattedValue = utility.GenerateFormattedMultipleValue (@DisplayFormat, @LookupObjectType, @LookupObjectID, @Value) end else begin set @formattedValue = [utility].[GetFormattedFieldLookupValue] (@Type, @DisplayFormat, @LookupObjectType, @LookupObjectID,@Value) end end return @formattedValue END
changeSet.rollback:
